# 100Tiki — Artificial Thatch Roofing for Resorts and Tiki Structures

> 100Tiki manufactures artificial thatch roofing — synthetic palm, nipa, kajan, reed, and safari thatch panels — for resort villas, overwater bungalows, tiki huts, gazebos, and theme parks, with fire-retardant options and a service life of 20+ years.

100Tiki supplies synthetic thatch as a direct replacement for natural palm and nipa roofing, which typically needs replacing every 3–5 years in humid coastal climates. Panels are UV-stabilised, mould-resistant, and available in fire-retardant grades for hospitality projects that must pass inspection. Products ship worldwide from China, with custom panel sizes and colours for project-scale orders.
